highlights_headline: The next 4.155 release updates image decoding, GLES interop, and the bundled HarfBuzz engine.
highlights_body: RAW and DNG decoding will no longer be available, while GLES interop moves to pointer-based signatures.

breaking.title: RAW and DNG image decoding is disabled
breaking.body: Applications that decode RAW or DNG images through SkiaSharp must use an alternative decoder before upgrading.

bullets.detail: OpenGL ES interop callers should update native interop code to use the new pointer-based signatures.
Refreshes the bundled text-shaping engine for the next release line.
